name: writ
description: An agent-first development process — BRD, identifier registry, dependency-ordered slice queue, CI gate, coverage ledger, and fourteen tuned project skills. /writ:solo for one developer plus agents on a new project, /writ:team for several, /writ:adopt to survey an existing codebase and put the process around it without blocking anyone who has not agreed to it, and /writ:update to offer an existing writ project what the kit has gained since.
